desc: Implement the online prefix-displacement set solution using coordinate tuples and a Python set.
Verify correctness on the provided samples and edge cases such as negative coordinates, unreachable targets, and long uniform wind strings.
If tuple hashing is too slow, implement an integer-encoded coordinate set with a safe base and bounds checking.
If the online set approach has subtle correctness issues, implement the two-pass first-occurrence dictionary approach as a fallback.
